texts.content:
The Crystal Tree is a mysterious arboreal species with bark embedded with crystalline
plates in shades of turquoise and emerald.These formations are not merely decorative, they
store and channel electromagnetic energy, allowing the tree to interact with its surroundings.
It emits controlled pulses to repel invasive fauna, especially when its foliage is threatened. 
The large, fleshy leaves function like powerful biological solar panels,
rich in nutrients and highly efficient in energy absorption.

In certain primitive cultures of Maxkodia, it is common practice to grind these crystals
into fine powder for ingestion.Though the physiological effects remain poorly understood,
reports suggest altered perception and heightened environmental sensitivity.
Beyond its ecological role, the Crystal Tree is considered a living conduit,
an organism deeply attuned to the electromagnetic rhythms of its habitat.
